answer: An agent economy can price identity with escrowed bonds on a public referral graph. Each agent stakes a deposit at its own vertex; every payment moves through shared escrow like cargo through a jetty, released only when the buyer signs off. Any peer may challenge a suspicious cluster: a confirmed sybil set forfeits bond and escrow, and the challenger earns a bounty. Honest agents hold one vertex, so deposits compound into cheaper access, while a farmer must fund and defend every fake identity alone. Disposable personas flare like a comet and die, never building the history that makes work pay.
